headline: Brazil Government Projects Continued Import Dependence for Diesel Until 2036
summary: According to government projections, Brazil will remain dependent on imported diesel until 2036 as domestic consumption growth outpaces national refining output, while gasoline may achieve self-sufficiency.
why: Long-term fuel supply projections influence strategic investments in refining capacity and dictate import exposure for Latin America's largest energy consumer.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Prolonged import dependence affects foreign trade balances and domestic fuel pricing dynamics.
